title: Agents can ask for an API key, and you approve it
items: An agent or API key that asks for a new API key gets a link and a code; you approve it on a page that shows the same code, who asked and from where, and the key goes only to whoever asked, once
API keys can be listed and revoked with an API key or a connected agent, not only from the dashboard

whk keys list, create and revoke, and whk approvals wait; client.apiKeys and client.approvals in the TypeScript SDK; list_api_keys, create_api_key, wait_for_approval and revoke_api_key in the MCP server
Under Connected agents, you can have every approval request emailed to you as well
